content: Provider primary sources show processing/retention varies by service, endpoint, account tier, and paid versus unpaid status. OpenAI documents default abuse-monitoring retention and eligible controls; Gemini terms distinguish unpaid input/output use and human review from paid-service processing. Provider rate limits and spend limits are project/account scoped, so Jobot must enforce its own per-user quotas and disclose the selected vendor terms. Anthropic data-usage page fetch failed; vendor terms remain unverified. Provider confidence classifier returns LOW, so verify contracting details before launch.
